The '''Battle of Janara III''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] raid on [[Janara III]] held by [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Alexandra, welcome to Sreina. You're on Janara III.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]], to Alexandra Winger|<ref name="SoG" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Garos|Liberation of Garos IV]], former [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|resistance fighter]] [[Alexandra Winger]] joined the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]], and according to her dreams and [[Force vision/Legends|Force Visions]], she became a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], flying with [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron]] as [[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]].<ref name="SoG" />

[[File:Alex_in_Xwing.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Winger in her [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]].]]

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], during a routine mission she attacked two [[TIE starfighter]]s with her squadron, when a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] appeared, which damaged her starfighter and captured her. Placed in cell for days and then transferred to a prison on [[Janara III]], she discovered that it was the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]]'s destroyer, the [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']], which had captured her. The old friend of her adoptive father, [[Tork Winger]], tried to make her talk, telling her that following its discovery in command of a Republican ship, her father and her "boyfriend" [[Dair Haslip]] had been arrested for complicity of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] and showing her the two men tortured on [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]].<ref name="SoG" />

==The battle==
[[File:Alex_stormtroopers_Janara.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Alexandra Winger]] during her custody on [[Janara III]].]]
{{Quote|A Lambda-class shuttle against Imperial starfighters?''"<br />"''It's good your friends showed up, eh?''"<br />"''Right.|Alexandra Winger and [[Dair Haslip]]|<ref name="SoG" />}}
But Haslip, safe and in a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] disguise, came to her rescue and told her about the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her father three months earlier of a heart attack. He also informed her that the New Republic reinforcements were incoming to rescue her. Escaped from the prison with her friend on a [[OP-5]] landspeeder, the young woman was chased by some [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] on their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] while the X-wing starfighter were attacking the Imperial facilities. During the pursuit Alex was shot in the hand, losing fingers, but they still managed to escape by stealing a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda'' shuttle]] and going into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="SoG" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Stop exaggerating. It's only a couple of fingers. Really, I'm okay. Let me get us out of here.|Alex Winger, to Dair Haslip|<ref name="SoG" />}}
Coming out of hyperspace, Alex decided that it was time for her to go on to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and entered the coordinates of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the computer.<ref name="SoG" />
